2024_OOF.note: MIXED trades are not in binary OOF validation cohorts; no OOF probabilities emitted

definitions.efficiency: absolute final completed close/entry return divided by cumulative absolute 1m returns seeded at entry price
definitions.imputation: training median; zero only if a training feature is wholly missing; explicit missing indicators
definitions.late_return: final completed close divided by close h minutes earlier, entry price may be the boundary seed
definitions.new_high: strict bar high above prior running peak initialized at entry price
definitions.volatility: population SD (ddof=0) of 1m close returns seeded at entry price
